description: This file exports constants and a module object related to diagram rendering, including a parser, configuration, and drawing functions for a quadrant chart visualization.

classes.name: class
classes.description: Configuration and data management class for quadrant chart visualization, including default settings, data, and theme configurations.

methods.name: getDefaultData
methods.description: Returns default data structure for the diagram, including title, quadrant texts, axis labels, and points.

methods.name: getDefaultConfig
methods.description: Returns default configuration settings for the chart layout, fonts, paddings, and border widths.

methods.name: getDefaultThemeConfig
methods.description: Returns default theme color settings for various chart elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets configuration, theme, and data to default values.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Updates the data object with new data.

methods.name: addPoints
methods.description: Adds new points to the existing data points array.

methods.name: calculateSpace
methods.description: Calculates layout space for axes and quadrants based on current configuration and data.

methods.name: getAxisLabels
methods.description: Generates axis label objects with position, fill, font size, and rotation.

methods.name: getQuadrants
methods.description: Returns quadrant boundary and label information based on layout calculations.

methods.name: getQuadrantPoints
methods.description: Maps data points to pixel coordinates within the quadrant layout.

methods.name: getBorders
methods.description: Calculates border line coordinates for the quadrants.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the chart title configuration if available.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the full diagram layout including points, quadrants, axes, borders, and title.
